title: Filed Driver Rating Plan — Age-Class Change of a Resident Listed Again on the Owner Auto Policy
content:
**Age-class change relativity.** Under the company's filed driver rating, an age-class change relativity multiplies the share of a household resident listed again on the Owner Auto Policy. The share is multiplied before it is rounded to the cent. The plan's age classes are:

| Age class | Ages | Class relativity |
|---|---|---|
| youth | under 21 | 1.85 |
| young | at least 21 and under 25 | 1.35 |
| standard | 25 or older | 1 |

The resident's age is taken in whole years from the date of birth on the resident's most recent entry on the term. A year is complete on the birthday, and a 29 February birthday completes on 1 March in a common year. The age is read on two dates:
- **the rating date:** the change effective date of the resident's most recent driver-added entry;
- **the report date:** the date of the claim report recording the resident operating as an unlisted household resident.

| Class on the rating date | Class on the report date | Relativity applied |
|---|---|---|
| youth | young | 1.35 divided by 1.85 |
| youth | standard | 1 divided by 1.85 |
| young | standard | 1 divided by 1.35 |
| unchanged | unchanged | 1 |

**Hypothetical illustration.**
- A resident aged 20 on the rating date and 21 on the report date moves from youth to young. The share is multiplied by 1.35 divided by 1.85, about 0.7297.
- A recorded share of 370.00 then becomes 270.00 before rounding.
